This is strictly a review based on their “friendly” customer service. I’m sorry but just because you end and email in “nice” way, it can still be rude and disrespectful. She in a “nice way” called me a liar gave wrong information and said it was my fault. When she realized she was wrong she made a rude comment that it doesn't matter that dates the order was approved cus it in the time frame which is true but also not I  think dates are important when paying so much and I  wanna track my package. Even though  she was wrong because it’s within her time frame she used that as an excuse instead of apologizing for her saying the wrong dates of my order details. Which I agree It is within the time frame however given false information and being rude isn’t acceptable on my end. No accountability and poor communication if she would have simply apologized for not giving the correct dates or said she misspoke but would try and at least help with the tracking issue I  would have been fine. I  mentioned the tracking not working multiple times I  was ignored and told it works for her so it’s working. When I  sent her the screen shot she ignored it and sent the same link. I also Requested to speak to a manager three times before she messaged me back “ no worries” “ our conversation has been forwards to our teams and managers”. Okay great thank you for doing that.  Now I hope I can speak To them please. She told me I need To “be kinder”. I explain To her multiple times to have a great holiday that I’m not upset with the dates but the tracking. That in the chance that she did state incorrect information I have every right to correct that information and I do not think that is rude. That is simply me double checking that we are on the same page here with the information that I have basic customer service skills. She told me I’d receive my tracking once it was shipped and I had To email her again to find out it Had already been shipped  and I was Sent a tracking 24 hours after it shipped. I placed my order 9th approved everything the day she reached out to me on the  11th. I then waited 7 business days to ask anything was was met with rude customer service. I’m so sad because I’m sure this was not the company but a her issue. Hopefully I hear From their management. But trusting her to actually get them for me. I’m not sure I can.really truly feeling disrespected attacked and upset.

EDIT:  I understand that you want to clean this up by saying you are resolving this.  The decals began peeling a month after installation.  Yes, I reached out after 8 months because they have peeled and curled to the point it has to be removed.  I spent almost $150 on 3 decals that should last longer than what I’ve experienced.  They have lines going through them and the color has faded.  When you go to pull it off, it “crumbles” or as I stated, disintegrates.  I was told that there has never been a problem before with them, insinuating that I was exaggerated or “lying”.  I was also to that even Amazon would not stand by a product after 8 months. So, Joy was insinuating that I was being unreasonable expecting better quality.  So now I’m a liar and ridiculous.  It was only after I wrote this review that I received possible solutions.  I never heard,”I’m sorry that the product did that” after 4 emails I received from them.  A company that stands by their products and cares for their customers would have said, after the apology, “Let us make this up to you.  Can we replace the decals for you?”  What is the cost of that to you? Is it worth insulting a good customer to save the 5 bucks or whatever to have a problem resolved?  Or, is it better to have you “customer service” people insult your customers.  I stand by my original review.  After your insults, after after you offered to do something when you saw my review, I told Mary that I’d rather warn the public than get a partial refund.  Thanks but no thanks…

I emailed with questions about the quality of my pillow and the lack of stuffing across the bottom, I wasn’t happy with it they gave me a credit I went to go buy another pillow to see if that was just a fluke and a mistake because my niece really wanted this pillow with her dogs picture on it so I use the credit Paid about $20 more which I figured I would just be able to order the same exact thing and not have additional fees so I reached out to them and asked them why I couldn’t use the coupon I received from a review from a different product I purchased and loved and their employee Mary accuse me of trying to gets free things and she was very rude and I felt her behavior was disgusting, not a good behavior to have from a small business it’s trying to make it good luck!!!

I can’t say enough good things about this company, the product and the communication. I have ordered two items so far and I’m sure I will order more. They make the perfect gift. They always send you a draft to review so you can approve it before they make the print. The dog prints I chose for my family were a MASSIVE hit!  They were hung up immediately. The canvas came out beautiful and arrived just as stated.  The company answered my emails promptly and offered to help with any questions I might have.  They offer you a preview of your purchase to make sure it’s just the way you want it.  Would highly recommend Dogvinci!

Ever since my first experience with doggovinci I continue to be more and more amazed at the standard of customer support especially from Joy and Joan, both ladies have been fantastic with responding to every question or concern I have.

The first items I ever ordered from doggovinci were the matching Hawaiian shirts for my dog Barchimedes and his granddad (my dad) I was very impressed with them. I left a review on Facebook about how good they were but happened to mention I’d have liked the dog one to have more of my dad’s face. I wasn’t expecting anything. I was happy with my purchase. But they reached out to me and said they would remake th dog shirt with the sizing of the faces smaller so that they fit better. I was so impressed. I chanced my arm to see if I could get the next size up, as Barchy’s shirt was just a little bit tight and I wanted it to last him. They were more than happy to do that even though that side of it was my error. 

I have continued buying products from them because I am now aware of the high standards they take in producing their items and how good they are at staying in contact all the way.

I have since ordered two small canvases two large canvases (both of which I asked for changes in the stock photo side of it, again happy to do this for me) I have ordered two large blankets, amazing quality and the picture is transferred fantastically!
4 decals, one large Christmas wrapping paper, a tumbler , 2 mugs. some of these I’m waiting to receive still but I have zero doubt they will be anything less than up to the phenomenal standards that everything else has been so far! The art team deserves all the recognition they can get. I had wanted a picture of Barchy as Harry Potter for ages and had been watching different companies. Some of the more recent efforts I have seen leave a lot to be desired and yes doggovinci is a little more expensive than others for their canvases but you see that extra in the quality of the canvas you receive and realise it’s very much deserved. Plus there is the fact that they give discounts regularly so you can make up the difference there. But I would rather pay the few extra euros knowing that what I get in return for my money is an amazing canvas!

Regarding the customer service. I feel I need to put this team in its own paragraph. I used to work in customer service all my working years. I arrived to give a high standard which I felt allowed me then to demand a high standard in return. 
I truly did my best and would go out of my way to help. But Joy and Joan blow me out of the water! They are phenomenal. They reply so quickly to any email any time (how they do this baffles me, I have insomnia and can be texting at any time day or night and one of these ladies will respond to me promptly!)
They are polite, they build rapport with the customer and have done so with me to the point I sign off my emails with my nickname and they address me with my nickname when they respond.
They are very attentive to each customer. I have mentioned various things that have been happening in my life around me or Barchy that delayed me in responding to them and they remember and might ask if everything is ok with it in our next correspondence. 

I really cannot get over how incredible the staff at doggovinci are. 

I have a Facebook group that was set up to help dogs and I have shared the images of the items I have ordered with the group and any discount codes that come my way via email. They are so impressed too and have often asked for the website address. So I hope some went and bought items for themselves. 

They are fun and great quality and a nice way to remember your fur-baby when their time to cross the rainbow bridge comes!

Thank you everyone at doggovinci you’re all phenomenal!!!
